title: trifolium arvense subsp. preslianum
intro: Trifolium arvense subsp. preslianum, commonly known as Presl's clover, is a plant species within the legume family that is native to various parts of the world. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Presl's clover include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive agent. The bioactive constituents of Presl's clover include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
